subject: A connected water system, pump cutaway, meter and illustrative data
styleLock: Same simple pastel cutaway, sage ground, cream supports, muted-blue housings, gold rotors and pale-blue water pipes.
motion: Causal pump operation and dependency-ordered cover reassembly.
Camera motion crosses beat boundaries continuously.
Circle-to-circle push and pull match cuts; no dissolves.
Existing Inter font, semantic word emphasis and short readable captions.
A shared clock drives pump and meter rotor; live counter samples the same flow.
limits: Conceptual pump/meter assemblies; no OEM or calibration accuracy claim.
All chart values are illustrative and labeled as such.

shots.action: Establish the connected water system and launch the explanatory motion.
Open the actual pump casing while the impeller turns.
Seat the same pump cover laterally, then axially.
Carry the circular pump opening into the meter rotor close-up.
Close the meter bezel and read its live model-bound flow.
Dock the same meter and reveal a model-bound numerical reading.
Grow category bars and their labels using an immutable common zero baseline.
Reveal recorded flow values with an explicit time axis.
Retain category identities and colors in a parts-of-whole view.
Return to the same operating house/pump/tank model.
